pairs.difference: A has small orange campfires on a fairly even yellow field. B has larger, closely repeated campfire emblems around a pale central glow, making the backdrop more prominent.
pairs.fix: Use a saturated yellow field with smaller, quiet orange campfire motifs and generous gaps.

pairs.difference: A uses broad blue rays behind the horn. B packs narrow rays around a conspicuous convergence point visible inside the horn's loop.
pairs.fix: Draw fewer, broader blue rays with subtle color differences; avoid a tight bright convergence inside the horn loop.

pairs.difference: A has a clear horizontal boundary between the red backdrop and orange ledge, with one simple steam curl. B merges the surface into the backdrop and adds several overlapping steam ribbons above the cup.
pairs.fix: Place the cup on a plain orange ledge against a red backdrop with a clear horizontal boundary. Draw one soft steam curl.

pairs.difference: Both baskets stand on a plain yellow ledge against a quiet purple backdrop. Neither adds background props or competing decoration.
A has a low open railing with blue sky visible through it. B places a tall solid wooden barrier behind the barrel, filling both sides with additional plank seams.
pairs.fix: Use a low wooden railing with a few widely spaced supports and open blue sky between them.

pairs.difference: Both taxis stand on a simple road with a few broad white markings and blue graphic rays behind them. Background complexity is comparable.
A frames the tent with large tree masses and a few flowers. B fills the forest behind the tent with many separate trunks, layered pointed trees and scattered grass marks across the foreground.
pairs.fix: Frame the tent with a few large trees and broad quiet foliage masses. Reduce distant trunks and foreground grass marks.

pairs.difference: A hangs the pot over a small exposed log fire on a plain dirt clearing. B adds a large stone fire ring beneath the pot and rope bindings on both supports, increasing secondary decoration.
pairs.fix: Hang the pot from a simple wooden crossbar over a few burning logs. Remove the surrounding stone ring and rope bindings.

pattern: Generated cards tend to make the surroundings more conspicuous through dense rays, enlarged motifs, extra scenery layers or added decorative props.
